_about: How one plan becomes one PDF per gender and weight range. A plan is written for a man of reference_weight kg; each size scales every portion by (weight / reference_weight) ^ exponent, times female_factor for women. Calorie needs grow slower than body weight, hence the exponent below 1. A plan can override any key under its own "sizes", e.g. {"genders": ["female"]} for a women-only diet.
